welcome.title: Grouper

Small groups.
Real meetups.
welcome.body: Every Thursday we put together a pod of 4–6 people near you who share something you care about. You meet in person.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: We tell you when your weekly drop is here, when your pod is confirmed, when there's a new message in your pod's meetup chat, and the morning after a meetup to ask how it went. Notifications never mention an interest, a person or what anyone wrote.

pledge.title: Our safety pledge
pledge.body: Meet only in public places, be kind and on time, and never pressure anyone. If something feels wrong, leave and use Report.

howMatchingWorks.title: How matching works
howMatchingWorks.inputs: Every Thursday we form pods of 4–6 people who share an interest. We use your interests, your approximate area (a map cell), your birth year, your age range, distance, meetup languages and times, and how reliably you attend.
howMatchingWorks.notUsed: We never use photos or anything we infer about you. Gender is used only if you turn on same-gender pods.
howMatchingWorks.sensitive: Sensitive interests are only used if you have agreed to them, only as the theme of a pod whose members all added them, and only after your account is 14 days old and you have attended a meetup.
howMatchingWorks.pauses: Some pauses happen automatically. Each comes with an explanation and ends by itself.
howMatchingWorks.humanReview: No person reviews these decisions. You can still use your data protection rights by contacting our privacy team (see the privacy notice).
howMatchingWorks.pause: You can pause matching at any time.

pauseList.reports: Two independent reports within 30 days, or one safety report, pause you for a while. The pause ends automatically.
pauseList.noShow: Two missed meetups within 8 weeks pause you for 2 weeks.
pauseList.underage: A “suspected under 18” report pauses the account for a while. The pause ends automatically.
pauseList.notGenuine: A “not a genuine member” report holds you out of pods about sensitive interests for 4 weeks.

tips.public: Meet in a public place in daytime or early evening.
tips.tellFriend: Tell a friend where you are going.
tips.leave: You can leave at any time.
tips.drink: Drink responsibly; there is no pressure to drink.
tips.report: Use Report if something feels wrong; call 112 in an emergency.

sensitive.title: Sensitive interests
sensitive.what: Some interests say something about your health, beliefs, sexuality, politics, ethnic origin or union membership. The law calls this special category data.
sensitive.where: If you have agreed to sensitive interests, we save them privately on your account, marked with a lock. They are never shown on any profile. If you have not agreed, we don’t save them at all.
sensitive.who: Such an interest is shown only as the theme of a pod, only to people invited to that pod who added it too.
sensitive.withdraw: You can withdraw your consent at any time in Settings → Privacy. We then delete all your sensitive interests and take you out of pods built around them. To stop one interest only, remove it.
sensitive.risk: We cannot verify who people are, so only share in a pod what you are comfortable with.
